ENERGİ-YE UMUMI-YE ROOZ
امروزه آسمان با energy-ye bi-nazir ve garm-e khod, ghalb-e mehraban-e shoma ra ba noor-e omid roshan mikonad. Ehsas-e amniyat va آرامش daron-e shoma afzayesh yafte ast va in emkan ra be shoma midahad ta ba did-e mosbat-e be donya negah konid. Rooz-e besyar khoobi baraye hal-e moshkelat-e ghabli va shorooe dobar-e ba ghodrat ast. Rooh-e shoma emrooz amade-ye paziroftan-e taghiirat-e ziba va mofid dar zendegi-st.

EHSASAT VA RABETE-HA
Baraye kasani ke dar rabete hastand, emrooz forsat-e alayi ast ta ba yek goft-e-goo-ye samimi va ašeqane, piyvand-e ahsasi-ye khod ra ba sharik-e zendegi-taneqviy konid. Agar mojarad hastid, ghalb-e shoma baraye yek ashnaee-ye jadid va por az mohabat amade ast; shayad emrooz kasi biayad ke garmayash rooh-e shoma ra garm konad. Ebtetei baraye esh-e vagheee dar rah ast ke labkhand ra be laban-e shoma baz migardanad.

KAR VA KARIYER
Dar mohit-e kari, emrooz setare-gan be nafe shoma melal mikonand va tavanayi-ha-ye modiriyati va ehsasi-ye shoma behtarin natayej ra midahad. Project-ha-ie ke ta konon ba moshkelat movajeh boodand, aknon ba rah-hal-e خلاقانه pish miravand. Az etminan be nafs-e khod estefade konid va pishnahad-e jadid ra bedoon-e tars pazirid; zira emrooz rooz-e derakhshesh-e shoma dar mohit-e kari ast.

POOLS VA BEREKAT
Vaziate mali-ye shoma dar masir-e pishraft va taadol gharar darad. Emrooz baraye سرمایه‌گذاری-ha-ye koochak ya barname-rizi baraye ayandeh zamani monaseb ast, ama bayad az kharid-ha-ye ehsasi va bi-morede parhiz konid. Kenaat va barname-rizi-ye doostane be shoma komak mikonad ta ehsas-e amniyat-e mali-ye bishtari dashte bashid va berekat dar zendegi-etan jari shavad.

SALAMATI VA ENERGİ
Jesm va rooh-e shoma emrooz niaz be estarahat va tamarkoz bar khod darad. Baraye hefz-e anrji-ye mosbat, varzesh-e sabok, meditaision ya zire noor-e aftab g قدم zadan be shoma energy-ye vijei midahad. Nooshidan-e ab-e kafi va estefade az ghaza-ha-ye salem va garm, hal-e zohor va jesm-e shoma ra behtarin shekl momken negah midahad.

ertebatat va mohit-e ejtemaei
Khanevade va doostan-e nazdik emrooz manba-ye bozorgi az anrji-ye garm va hemayat baraye shoma hastand. Goftegoo ba kasani ke dostashon darid، hal-e roohi-ye shoma ra besyar behtar mikonad va ahsas-e tanhaee ra az shoma door misazad. Mohit-e khanevade emrooz por az shadi, garmay-e ahsasi va aramsh ast.

TAVSIYE-YE ROOZ
Be ghalb-e khod etminan konid; seda-ye daron-e shoma hichgah shoma ra be rah-e eshtebah nemibard va be shoma rah-e dorost ra neshon midahad.

JAZBIYYAT VA JONBESH-E ROOZ
Adad-e Shans: 2, 7, 11
Rang-e Shans: Sefid-e Sedaqat, Noqrei-ye Darakhshan
Borj-e Hamahang: Aban va Mardan
